rows.en:
Still, who's that person who's always
with Sheryl...?
That's my very capable manager, Grace.

Huh, so that's who that is...
...Wait, Sheryl!?
rows.notes: Shared by both genders; the female player says bare 'Sheryl' here as in the Japanese (she usually says Sheryl-san).

rows.en:
Hi~
Seeing you this surprised makes it
worth calling out to you.
Hee hee, see you.
Huh? Oh, uh, see you...
(The Galactic Fairy actually talked to me...)

(Still, who's that person who's always
with Sheryl, I wonder?)
(The Galactic Fairy actually talked to me...)

She's the girl I gave my seal of approval to.
Of course she's doing this well.

Wow, she's really something.
...Wait, Sheryl!?

Ranka-chan's going to keep growing and growing.
If I let my guard down, even I might...

It's nothing!
I'll be taking my leave for today.
Oh, okay. See you.

(Ranka's amazing, getting recognized
by the Galactic Fairy herself.)

Wow, she's really something.
...Wait, Sheryl-san!?

(Ranka-chan's amazing, getting recognized
by the Galactic Fairy herself.)

(P.E. today is swimming, huh... Hm? Alto and
Sheryl... Are they arguing about something...?)

Oh my, Alto. Looks like you can't take your
eyes off me in my swimsuit.

Wha-!?
As if I'd look at someone like you...

Really?
Your face looks awfully red, though...
That's... because you...

Oh, come on, you're so bad at being honest!
But that's what makes you cute!
Why, you!
Um, you two...

Oh, if it isn't \p.
You tell him too:
"Be honest with yourself."
What nonsense are you spouting!?

"I couldn't take my eyes off Sheryl-sama
in her swimsuit~" Just like that!
Grr, why... you... little...!

(P.E. today is swimming, huh... Hm?
Saotome-kun and Sheryl-san...
Are they arguing about something...?)
Um, you two...

Oh, if it isn't \p-chan.
You tell him too:
"Be honest with yourself."

(Okay, maybe I'll head home soon...
Oh, it's Sheryl and Ranka...
Something feels seriously tense...)

I don't agree!
Ranka-chan, you're wrong!

No, I'm not!
You're the one who's wrong, Sheryl-san!

Grr, you're so stubborn!
If words won't get through to you...!

Whoa, you two, hold on a sec!
Why are you so worked up?
Oh, if it isn't \p...

Listen to this, Sheryl-san is being awful!
We were talking about what the tastiest sweet
in all of Macross Frontier is, and...
It's the "hippo-cow soft serve," hands down!

No way, it isn't!
It's definitely Nyan-Nyan's
"Zentradi Sesame Balls"!
rows.notes: Zentora goma dango: 'Zentradi Sesame Balls' (not in glossary; goma dango is 'sesame balls' in earlier slices, Zentora-don was 'Zentradi Rice Bowl' in MUF).

rows.en:
You really won't listen, will you!
Fine! We're going to go eat them right now
and settle which one's truly the best!

(Okay, maybe I'll head home soon...
Oh, it's Sheryl-san and Ranka-chan...
Something feels seriously tense...)

You two, hold on a sec!
Why are you so worked up?

(Next class is P.E.
I'd better hurry out to the schoolyard...)

(Hm? Sheryl and Nanase are talking.
What's going on?)

Ever since I saw you in the shower that time,
something's been bugging me...

Could it be that your chest...
is bigger than mine?
Wha-!
Come on, let me check.
P-please stop it! Sheryl-san!

Oh, what's the harm?
It's not like they'll shrink...
(I really need to help Nanase out here...)

Sheryl, you're making Nanase uncomfortable.
Come on, quit checking.

Popping up out of nowhere to get in my way...
Pretty cheeky of you, \p.

Oh, fine.
Then, \p, you decide
whose chest is bigger!
Hurry up and decide!
Uh, well...

We'll be late for P.E. if we don't hurry.
Come on, let's go!
Hey, what are you running away for!

(I can't exactly go staring at those two's
chests, so please, give me a break!)

(Next class is P.E.
I'd better hurry out to the schoolyard...)

(Hm? Sheryl-san and Nanase are talking.
What's going on?)
(I really need to help Nanase out here...)

Sheryl-san, you're making Nanase uncomfortable.
Please stop checking.

Popping up out of nowhere to get in my way...
You've got some nerve, \p-chan.

Oh, fine.
Then, \p-chan, you decide
whose chest is bigger!

We'll be late for P.E. if we don't hurry.
Let's go!

(We may all be girls, but staring at their
chests would be too embarrassing.
Please, give me a break!)
